title: Jammy Moroccan Morbier Tagine
description: A sweet and savory Moroccan dish made with morbier cheese, featuring a jammy texture and energizing flavors. Perfect for a relaxing breakfast or brunch, this tagine is an Ayurvedic and Tamasic-friendly option.

ingredients.name: Morbier cheese
ingredients.notes: white sheep milk and beige cow milk blend

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: kala namak or flaky sea salt

instructions: In a large cast-iron clay tagine or Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chopped apricots and cook, stirring occasionally, until they're softened and lightly caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the pistachios and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant and lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cinnamon, ginger, turmeric, and salt. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the orange blossom water and honey. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the morbier cheese. Cook, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth.
Transfer the tagine to the oven and cook at 375°F for 10-12 minutes, or until the tagine is hot and the cheese is melted and slightly puffed.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
